name: Primetime
description: The broadcast look, first worn by Archie's: the condensed display face in italic caps for headings and section titles, team-colored paint, and no editorial furniture: no stripe beside a title (a short slanted accent sits under it instead), no outline on a card (a soft shadow lifts it off the page instead).

tokens.--style-section-mark: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 0.1rem, var(--league-accent, var(--color-primary)) 0.1rem, var(--league-accent, var(--color-primary)) calc(100% - 0.1rem), transparent calc(100% - 0.1rem)) left bottom / 2.75rem 0.25rem no-repeat
